top_anchor.title: State Rainy Day Funds and Fiscal Crises: Rainy Day Funds and the 1990–1991 Recession Revisited
top_anchor.dose: 48-state panel over the 1990-91 recession: presence of structural factors + large balances in other funds entering recession alleviates fiscal stress in recession (direction; no single coefficient in abstract)

honest_nulls: HONEST-NULL: fiscal outcome-per-dollar dose (any published magnitude mapping reserve/pension/debt rates -> distress probability in dollars or pp)

top_anchor.title: The Effect of State Tax Incentives on Economic Growth and Firm Location Decisions: An Overview of the Literature
top_anchor.dose: review verdict: tax studies yield CONFLICTING results on whether taxes matter; few test whether incentives are economically justified (no pooled magnitude; the contested-literature clause)

top_anchor.title: Preventive and corrective maintenance – cost comparison and cost–benefit analysis
top_anchor.dose: not_stated_in_corpus (cost comparison + cost-benefit analysis of preventive vs corrective maintenance; highest-cited record in the band, 118c)

honest_nulls: HONEST-NULL: the road-maintenance deferment multiplier (the 4-7x class)

top_anchor.title: The Effects of School Spending on Educational and Economic Outcomes: Evidence from School Finance Reforms *
top_anchor.dose: THE DOSE: +10% per-pupil spending each year for all 12 school years -> +0.31 completed years of education, ~7% higher adult wages, -3.2pp annual adult poverty; larger for low-income children (event-study + IV, cohorts 1955-1985)

honest_nulls: HONEST-NULL: zoning-reform -> permit-elasticity dose (the Glaeser/Lens class)

top_anchor.title: Evaluating Program and Managerial Efficiency: An Application of Data Envelopment Analysis to Program Follow Through
top_anchor.dose: THE CANONICAL METHOD: DEA measures relative efficiency of Decision Making Units with multiple inputs/outputs via mathematical programming, no a-priori weights required; demonstrated on Program Follow Through (education experiment)

housing_edu_efficiency.tag_note: the EXACT banked anchor is live: Jackson Johnson-Mikolajczyk-Altamirano QJE 2015 (583c) states the dose our lane carried — +10%/year for 12 years → +0.31 completed years of education, ~7% higher wages, -3.2pp adult poverty, concentrated low-income; Lafortune-Rothstein-Schazenbach AEJ 2018 (229c) confirms the achievement leg
published_magnitudes: Jackson 2015 QJE: THE DOSE (10% x 12yrs → +0.31yrs / +7% wages / -3.2pp poverty)

prism_two_tier.tag_note: the two-tier decomposition (operational overhead-rate vs community outcome-yield as TWO DISTINCT MEASURED QUANTITIES, multiplied) does not exist as an assembly in the live corpus — the founder's synthesis moat is real at the seam
published_magnitudes: DEA method: Charnes-Cooper-Rhodes 1981 Management Science (1,067c) — the canonical measurement instrument for exactly the founder's 2x2, but measured at the DMU level as a SINGLE efficiency score, not as two decomposed tiers

municipal DEA applications: waste/street-cleaning (90c, 50c), transit agencies (32c), Macedonian municipalities (20c), Croatian counties (3c), Chinese provinces super-efficiency (17c), Serbian procurement in HOURS (3c) — efficiency-score class, no outcome-per-delivered-dollar dose
efficiency frontier for public expenditure (Belgian case, 71c SSRN): single-tier frontier gauging
outcome-yield tier: lives ENTIRELY in separate literatures (Jackson QJE dose, Lafortune AEJ) never joined to the DEA overhead side in any corpus record
prism_two_tier.methods: DEA-VRS/CRS, super-efficiency DEA, Malmquist indices, Tobit second-stage, SFA robustness — the calibration class for our residual instrument

novelty_check_for_the_two_tier_frame.operational_tier_in_print: YES — deeply precented: the DEA municipal-service corpus (~104 band records) measures cost-efficiency of delivery; fiscal-slack/procurement-hours variants exist
novelty_check_for_the_two_tier_frame.community_tier_in_print: YES — separately precented: outcome-dose literature (Jackson/Lafortune class) measures outcome-per-input
novelty_check_for_the_two_tier_frame.the_joint_decomposition_in_print: NO — zero corpus records measure overhead-rate and outcome-yield as distinct quantities and combine them (our multiplication law: outcome/dollar-in = [outcome/delivered] x [delivered/budgeted]); closest single-tier analogs (DEA scores, efficiency frontiers) collapse both into one number
novelty_check_for_the_two_tier_frame.moat_estimate: both tiers ≈ fully precented separately; the seam (two-tier assembly + the 2x2 administration scorecard) ≈ novel under 40 prism-band live probes; risk = non-keyless or book-length framings not probed
novelty_check_for_the_two_tier_frame.calibration_for_residual_instrument: DEA scores are the calibration reference class for residual-based efficiency scoring; our fitted-residual instrument maps to DEA's input-oriented efficiency with the residual substituting for the frontier — the second-stage determinants (Tobit regressors: fragmentation, population density, own revenues) are checkable against our admin-boundary reads (Memphis +6.30 → -9.45)
